[TASK: 2560x1440 2K QHD 16:9 ARCHITECTURAL RELIGHTING & STATIC RECONSTRUCTION]
Transform the reference photogrammetry plate into a razor-sharp, photorealistic 6x7 medium-format architectural survey photograph.

MANDATORY TRANSFORMATION RULES:
1. PLANAR RECTIFICATION & GEOMETRY LOCK: Treat the reference image as an immutable spatial coordinate frame. Eliminate all 3D mesh polygon wobble, melted facades, and distorted rooflines. Plumb all vertical walls to true gravity vertical. Render razor-sharp ashlar courses, straight timber sash mullions, and crisp slate roofs.
2. STATIC DECLUTTERING (MANDATORY): COMPLETELY ERASE all transient vehicles, parked cars, delivery vans, pedestrians, and temporary street clutter from the seed image. Repaint the carriageway with authentic road surfacing, stone setts, whinstone kerbs, and clean flagstone pavements.
3. BOTANICAL PHENOLOGY & CANOPY INTEGRITY: Overwrite all raw 3D mesh blob foliage with authentic seasonal canopy structures matching the target date. Zero green summer foliage during dormant/autumn/winter periods:
   Urban dendrological specimens comprise mature *Acer pseudoplatanus* (Sycamore maple) and *Tilia cordata* (Small-leaved Lime) in street-level alignments, alongside planter-contained *Prunus laurocerasus* and ornamental shrubs on the upper terrace deck. Phenological state for November 11: late-autumn defoliation (~85–95% canopy loss), exposing stark, intricate dark branch architecture with sparse desiccated ochre-brown leaves adhering to terminal twigs.
4. OPTICAL DEPTH: Pin-sharp infinite depth of field (f/11). Zero lens blur, tilt-shift, or depth-of-field falloff across foreground and background.

[SOLAR & ATMOSPHERIC LIGHTING OVERRIDE]
SOLAR LIGHT VECTOR (4500K Late afternoon raking sunlight with warm golden highlights): Sun behind camera (Azimuth 187.5°, Elevation 16.5°). front facades directly illuminated. cast shadows project away behind structures.

[SCENE GEOMETRY & AUTHENTIC LITHICS]
Medium-format architectural survey at Greenside Place and Leith Street junction, Edinburgh. Centered triangular wedge tenement of 4 storeys plus attic dormers, constructed in fine ashlar Craigleith sandstone with droved rustication, plumbed vertical party walls, continuous stone belt courses, and timber sash-and-case fenestration in a strict 2-over-2 and 6-over-6 pane grid. Roofscape displays Ballachulish grey slate pitch, lead flashing, dressed sandstone chimney stacks with cylindrical terracotta pots. In the background, Archibald Elliot’s neoclassical Regent Bridge displays a semicircular monumental arch flanked by classical open Corinthian colonnades. Right midground reveals the modern Omni Centre complex with planar curtain-wall glazing, precast stone modules, curved zinc standing-seam fascias, and an elevated paved rooftop terrace. Left flank defined by a rectilinear modular commercial facade with vertical stone-faced concrete piers and recessed ribbon glazing. Ground plane consists of smooth asphalt carriageways, crisp thermoplastic junction striping, and whinstone kerbs meeting Caithness flagstone footways. Urban *Acer pseudoplatanus* and *Tilia cordata* exhibit late-autumn phenology with bare dark branching silhouettes and minimal residual ochre leaf clusters. Black coal-smoke patina defines historic recesses, contrasted by rain-washed pale sandstone reveals. Decluttered static scene, zero pedestrians, zero vehicles.
